summary: Ukrainian forces conducted multiple drone and missile attacks targeting Russian infrastructure in Moscow region, Odesa, and Luhansk, causing casualties and damage to fuel facilities and port areas. Russia responded with increased air defenses, intercepting hundreds of drones and launching missile strikes on Ukrainian territories. Domestic protests in Ukraine intensified following the dismissal of Defense Minister Fedorov, with calls for his return and criticism of military leadership. (Source: @UkraineNow/82745)
key_points: Ukrainian drone attacks struck a fuel base in Moscow region and damaged port infrastructure in Odesa, killing one and injuring three. (Source: @UkraineNow/82745)
Russia intercepted 379 Ukrainian drones over its regions and maritime areas, with fires reported at a fuel depot in Noginsk. (Source: @tass_agency/385865)
Protests erupted across Ukrainian cities demanding the return of Fedorov and resignation of Syrsky, reflecting public dissatisfaction with military leadership. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23660)
Missile threats from Bryansk region targeted Odesa and Chernomorsk, with warnings of Iskander-M launches. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69124)
A rail bridge in Luhansk region was damaged, disrupting Russian military logistics. (Source: @UkraineNow/82745)
Belarus imposed fuel purchase limits near borders to prevent smuggling to Russia amid shortages. (Source: @eRadarrua/101519)
Ukrainian forces attacked a Naftogaz facility in Kharkiv region, according to company reports. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31714)
US diesel prices surged due to Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries, causing global shortages. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31723)
